'''Padija Anjeri''' was a [[Sentientologist|anthropologist]] and [[operative]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The daughter of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Tyneir Renz]], Anjeri studied at the [[University of Alderaan/Legends|University of Alderaan]] where she was recruited into the Alliance by [[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Oll Maccabe]]. Anjeri worked as a recovery agent, rescuing relics and artifacts from historical sites destroyed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. During a mission to [[Omman Minor]], Anjeri hired the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Drake Paulsen]] to transport her off-world after she recovered an idol important to the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Nercathi clan]].<ref name="II" />
